name: pipeline-medic-e2e
description: End-to-end, visual and accessibility tests for the static demo page (demo/public).

scripts.test:docker: docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD/..:/work" -w /work/e2e mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.65.0-noble /bin/bash -c "npm ci && npx playwright test"
scripts.test:docker:update: docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD/..:/work" -w /work/e2e mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.65.0-noble /bin/bash -c "npm ci && npx playwright test --update-snapshots"
